orders.instruction_en: Set up a ramp at the hallway door threshold (about 18.2 cm high, over 3 cm).
orders.instruction_zh: 在走廊門門檻處（高約18.2公分，超過3公分）設置坡道。

orders.instruction_en: Secure or remove the rug at the hallway door off the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 將走廊門處不在動線上的地毯固定或移除。

orders.instruction_en: Clear or move the cable at the hallway door covering 36% of the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 清除或移走走廊門處壓在行走動線上36%的線纜。

orders.instruction_en: Clear or move the cable at the hallway door covering 19% of the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 清除或移走走廊門處壓在行走動線上19%的線纜。

orders.instruction_en: Clear or move the cable in the hallway to bathroom covering 41% of the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 清除或移走走廊到浴室處壓在行走動線上41%的線纜。

orders.instruction_en: Clear or move the shoes in the hallway to bathroom covering 88% of the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 清除或移走走廊到浴室處壓在行走動線上88%的鞋子。

orders.instruction_en: Clear or move the shoes in the hallway to bathroom covering 58% of the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 清除或移走走廊到浴室處壓在行走動線上58%的鞋子。

orders.instruction_en: Clear or move the slippers in the hallway to bathroom covering 100% of the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 清除或移走走廊到浴室處壓在行走動線上100%的拖鞋。

orders.instruction_en: Clear or move the slippers in the hallway to bathroom covering 100% of the walking path.
orders.instruction_zh: 清除或移走走廊到浴室處壓在行走動線上100%的拖鞋。

orders.instruction_en: Apply anti-slip treatment in the bathroom and clear standing water.
orders.instruction_zh: 在浴室進行防滑處理，並清除地面積水。

orders.instruction_en: Install a grab bar beside the toilet in the bathroom.
orders.instruction_zh: 在浴室馬桶旁加裝扶手。

summary_en: Home environment paperwork for a wheelchair user: hallway door threshold needs a ramp, cables, shoes and slippers on the hallway door and hallway to bathroom paths need clearing, rug needs securing or removal, bathroom needs anti-slip treatment and a grab bar beside the toilet. Three items correspond to subsidy codes FA31, FA35, FA22.
summary_zh: 輪椅使用者居家環境文書：走廊門門檻需設坡道，走廊門及走廊到浴室動線上的線纜、鞋子、拖鞋需清除或移位，地毯固定或移除，浴室需防滑處理並在馬桶旁加裝扶手。其中3項對應補助代碼FA31、FA35、FA22。
